title: GPT-6 Astra Just Moved a Mathematical Boundary
description:
OpenAI says GPT-6 Astra helped improve a bounded-prime-gap result from 240 to 186—and improve a separate large-prime-gap term that had stood for more than 80 years. Proof materials are public, but expert human verification still matters.

Source: https://openai.com/index/gpt-6-astra/
